title: Password reset email not received
description: User requested a password reset but the reset email never arrived. Spam folder checked.

resolution.summary: Re-send the reset link from the admin console and ask the user to allow-list noreply@example.test.

title: Account locked after failed login attempts
description: User is locked out after entering the wrong password five times.

resolution.summary: Unlock the account from the admin console and send the user a password reset link.

title: MFA code not accepted
description: Authenticator app codes are rejected at login even though they are freshly generated.

resolution.summary: Phone clock was out of sync; ask the user to enable automatic time, then re-enrol MFA if it persists.

title: SSO login redirect loop
description: Users signing in through Okta SSO are redirected back to the login page endlessly.

resolution.summary: Customer IdP certificate had rotated; update the SAML signing certificate in the tenant settings.

title: Session expires too quickly
description: Users are signed out after a few minutes of inactivity in the web app.

resolution.summary: Raise the tenant idle session timeout from 5 to 30 minutes in security settings.

title: Invoice shows duplicate charge
description: Customer was charged twice for the monthly subscription invoice.

resolution.summary: Void the duplicate invoice in the billing system and issue a refund to the original payment method.

title: Refund not received after cancellation
description: Customer cancelled the subscription two weeks ago and has not received the promised refund.

resolution.summary: Refund was stuck in the payment processor queue; re-submit it and confirm the transaction id with the customer.

title: Update billing address on invoice
description: Customer wants their new company address shown on future invoices.

resolution.summary: Update the billing address in the account billing profile; it applies from the next invoice.

title: Download past invoices as PDF
description: Customer asks how to download invoices from previous months as PDF files.

resolution.summary: Invoices are under Settings, Billing, Invoice history; each row has a PDF download button.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
description: API returns 500 errors under load; logs show the database connection pool is exhausted.

resolution.summary: Raise max pool size from 20 to 50 and fix the leaked connection in the report export job.

title: Replication lag on read replica
description: Reports show stale data; the read replica is several minutes behind the primary database.

resolution.summary: Long-running analytics query was blocking replay; move it to the warehouse and add a statement timeout.

title: Slow report export
description: Exporting the quarterly report takes over five minutes and sometimes times out.

resolution.summary: Add an index on reports(account_id, created_at) and stream the export instead of building it in memory.

title: Dashboard loads slowly for large accounts
description: The main dashboard takes 20 seconds to load for accounts with many projects.

resolution.summary: Paginate the project list and cache the summary widgets for 60 seconds.

title: Phishing email impersonating support
description: Several users received an email pretending to be from our support team asking for their password.

resolution.summary: Reported the sending domain for takedown, published a customer notice and forced password resets for users who clicked.

title: API key leaked in public repository
description: A customer API key was found committed to a public GitHub repository.

resolution.summary: Revoked the key, issued a new one, and audited API access logs for misuse.

title: Checkout returns 500 on empty cart
description: Submitting checkout with an empty cart crashes with a 500 error and a stack trace.

resolution.summary: Guard against a missing items list in cart.total so an empty cart totals 0 instead of crashing.
resolution.patch:
diff --git a/cart.py b/cart.py
index 99fff60..a6359c7 100644
--- a/cart.py
+++ b/cart.py
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@ def total(items):
 
     Each item is a dict with a unit ``price`` and a ``qty``.
     """
-    return sum(item["price"] * item["qty"] for item in items)
+    return sum(item["price"] * item["qty"] for item in items or [])
 
 
 def checkout(cart):

title: Mobile app crashes on startup after update
description: After updating to the latest version the iOS app crashes immediately on launch.

resolution.summary: Corrupted cache from the previous version; shipped a hotfix that clears the cache on upgrade.

title: Email notifications delayed
description: Notification emails arrive hours after the event that triggered them.

resolution.summary: Email worker queue was backed up; scaled workers from 2 to 6 and added queue-depth alerting.

title: CSV import fails with encoding error
description: Importing a CSV file exported from Excel fails with an invalid UTF-8 error.

resolution.summary: Ask the user to export as CSV UTF-8 from Excel, or enable the Latin-1 option in the import dialog.

title: User cannot change display name
description: The save button is disabled when a user tries to change their display name in profile settings.

resolution.summary: Display names are managed by the customer's SSO directory; ask their admin to change it there.
